Two fresh native builds of the dram-rom-symbols record's 128 selections, one with the base commit's build_bus.py and one with this and runtime_join.py, in the pinned toolchain image with the static stock loader and octabam's compiler memo, everything else the base commit's, including Sidechain Compressor's folder without placement.json, so the builder is the only difference. Every built image is identical (98) and every refusal is identical (30). Sidechain Compressor 0.2.2's placement is compared in its own record (sdk/native-comparisons/sidechain-compressor.json). No hardware result is inferred.
